author: smuzaffar
body:
This fixes the wrong dict association for MtdSimMergedCluster ( see https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52123#issuecomment-7193722126 ) . This should fix the wrong dict errors from 20.1.X IBs

https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/showDupDict.py/el9_amd64_gcc14/www/wed/20.1-wed-23/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-25-2300/testLogs/dupDict-lostDefs.log
```
 ./SimDataFormats/Associations/src/classes_def.xml defines the following dictionaries that should be defined in another package 	
TrackingAnalysis : edm::helpers::KeyVal< edm::RefProd< vector< MtdSimMergedCluster > >, edm::RefProd< vector< TrackingParticle > > >
TrackingAnalysis : edm::helpers::KeyVal< edm::RefProd< vector< TrackingParticle > >, edm::RefProd< vector< MtdSimMergedCluster > > > 
```
title: Update dict association for MtdSimMergedCluster
